article.headline: Jervis, Scott lead balanced attack as No. 6 Michigan State rolls past Toledo, 91-61
article.description: — Freshman Jasiah Jervis scored 16 points and Jordan Scott had 12 points, nine rebounds and five assists as No. 6 Michigan State overpowered Toledo 91-61 on Thursday night.
article.linkText: Jervis, Scott lead balanced attack as No. 6 Michigan State rolls past Toledo, 91-61
article.story: EAST LANSING, Mich. -- — Freshman Jasiah Jervis scored 16 points and Jordan Scott had 12 points, nine rebounds and five assists as No. 6 Michigan State overpowered Toledo 91-61 on Thursday night. Preseason All‑American Jeremy Fears Jr. had 12 points and nine assists. Coen Carr added 10 points for the Spartans (2-0), who led by 33 points. Anton Bonke had nine points and grabbed seven rebounds. Michigan State had a 52-27 rebounding advantage and scored 27 second-chance points, compared to Toledo's six. Mynor Strong led the Rockets (0-2) with 11 points, and Jaylan Ouwinga added 10. The Rockets were limited to 25% shooting from the field in the first half as the Spartans raced to a 48-25 lead. Toledo's Angel Montas Jr. scored the first basket of the game. The Spartans then reeled off 17 straight points, with Jervis scoring eight of his 13 first-half points. Michigan State led by double digits the rest of the way. Up next Toledo: At Marshall on Saturday.
